description: Gnome association notice: Bartholomew is 3.5 ft, over the 3-ft cap; $25 fine, waived if fixed by 2026-09-30
body:
WOBBLESTONE LANE GNOME ASSOCIATION
Notice of breach, 2 September 2026

To: 14 Wobblestone Lane
Gnome: Bartholomew, measured at 3.5 feet
Rule: no garden gnome may stand taller than 3 feet
Fine: $25, waived if the gnome is brought under 3 feet by 30 September 2026

Agatha Grimsby, President

description: Gnome association fined me $25: my gnome Bartholomew stands 3.5 feet, over the 3-foot cap
body: A notice from the gnome association, signed by Mrs. Grimsby as president: my gnome Bartholomew stands 3.5 feet, over the 3-foot cap. Fine of $25, waived if he is brought under 3 feet by 2026-09-30.
